system.description:
Tearing open the Shroud, you step bodily into the harrowing lands of the dead, where vengeful spirits wait and neither blood nor sustenance can be found.

Mark a doorway with chalk or blood, taking a full turn to do so. Then expend a Willpower Trait and two Blood Traits and make a Static Physical Challenge against a difficulty of eight Traits. On a success you step through into the Underworld. To return, focus your intent and expend a Willpower Trait to reappear in the living world at the end of the turn. You carry only inanimate objects; you cannot bring other living or undead creatures, and guns and electronics do not function in the deadlands.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
